changelog:
- Total Removal of Homescreen Bottom Bar: Guaranteed complete removal of bottom native bar on the start page across app resume, orientation change, tab switching, and initial load.
- Complete Bridge & Action Functionality: All 4 squircle feature buttons (Favorites, History, AdShield, Settings) as well as the middle Command Card's tab counter badge and three-dots menu are fully wired and functional.
- Synchronized Webpage Navigation Flow: Submitting search/URL smoothly transitions from the homescreen Command Card to the webpage with full native toolbar (Tabs badge and Three-Dots bottom sheet with Back, Forward, Reload, Home, etc.).
